description: This file contains a static utility class 'Utils' with various helper methods for string representations, URI parsing, exception handling, batching, and stack trace retrieval, used within the Orleans runtime project.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A static class providing various utility methods for string formatting, URI parsing, exception handling, batching, and diagnostics within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: EnumerableToString
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable collection to a human-readable string, with options for formatting.

methods.name: DictionaryToString
methods.description: Converts a collection of key-value pairs to a human-readable string representation.

methods.name: TimeSpanToString
methods.description: Formats a TimeSpan object into a human-readable string.

methods.name: AverageTicksToMilliSeconds
methods.description: Converts a float value of ticks to milliseconds.

methods.name: ToIPEndPoint
methods.description: Parses a Uri with scheme 'gwy.tcp' into an IPEndPoint.

methods.name: ToGatewayAddress
methods.description: Parses a Uri with scheme 'gwy.tcp' into a SiloAddress, excluding generation.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri (IPEndPoint)
methods.description: Converts an IPEndPoint to a gateway URI.

methods.name: ToGatewayUri (SiloAddress)
methods.description: Converts a SiloAddress to a gateway URI.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an Action safely, catching and ignoring exceptions.

methods.name: SafeExecute (overload)
methods.description: Executes an Action safely with optional logging of exceptions.

methods.name: SafeExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a Task asynchronously, catching and ignoring exceptions.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack trace, skipping a specified number of frames.
